tagline: Clean lines. Smooth walls. Precision finish.
about:
Fresh walls. Clean edges. A home ready for its next chapter.

We help homeowners, landlords and small businesses with skimming, ceiling repairs, plasterboarding and renovation plastering, alongside exterior rendering.

From a single ceiling to a whole-property refresh, expect clear advice, careful preparation and a tidy finish.

Working across Hucknall, Nottingham and surrounding areas. Interior work continues through autumn and winter; exterior rendering is planned around suitable weather.

Your next step
Send a few photos and a short description of the work for a free, no-obligation quote. Prefer to talk it through? Call 07432 523726.

Monday-Friday: 8am-6pm
Saturday: 9am-5pm
Alternative number: 07736 233404
